## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `milvus-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Option 2: Managed instance with Zilliz Cloud

1. <!-- manual: Visit [Zilliz Cloud](https://cloud.zilliz.com/) and create an account. -->
2. <!-- manual: Complete the account setup process. -->
3. From the welcome page, select **Create Cluster**.
4. <!-- manual: Configure cluster details including cluster name, cloud provider, and region. -->
5. Once the cluster is created, download the connection details and credentials.
6. <!-- manual: Navigate to the API Keys section in your cluster dashboard and generate an API key for authentication. -->
